settings.station_id.label: Station ID
settings.station_id.description: Buienradar measuring station ID (e.g. 6279 = Hoogeveen). 0 picks the station nearest to the coordinates below.
settings.latitude.label: Latitude
settings.latitude.description: Used for the nearest station and for the rain outlook. Default: Emmen.
settings.longitude.label: Longitude
settings.longitude.description: Used for the nearest station and for the rain outlook. Default: Emmen.
settings.page_url.label: Buienradar page
settings.page_url.description: Opened in the default browser by the link at the bottom of the panel. Copy the URL of your place from buienradar.nl.
settings.refresh_minutes.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
settings.refresh_minutes.description: How often to fetch new data from Buienradar.
